match: \[rar\] unpack of .* failed|Extraction to directory .* failed
what: A RAR unpack failed: that download is not imported
do: Open the arr app's queue, remove that download and let it search again.

what: A finished download did not land where it should
do: Check the arr app's queue for an import warning and import it by hand.

match: irc: (banned from network|error state reached|transitioning to error state|irc networks unhealthy)
what: autobrr's IRC announce feed is down or banned
do: Open autobrr, IRC page: reconnect the network, or check the tracker for a ban.

match: Unable to connect to Deluge|Unable to retrieve queue and history items from Deluge
what: Sonarr/Radarr/Lidarr could not reach Deluge
do: Check Deluge and its VPN container are up; restart Deluge if it is stuck.
why: only a gap of 30+ minutes counts; short busy gaps flood the operator. Hold lifted 2026-11-16: 16 of the 21 short gaps in 7 days were during the old all-day Glacier run (11-15), none since it moved to 22:00; longest 15 min, so none would have been sent

what: Sonarr/Radarr/Lidarr were refused by Deluge (password)
do: Re-enter the Deluge password in each arr app's download client settings.

what: An indexer login failed in Jackett
do: Open Jackett, test that indexer and renew its login or cookie.

match: ffprobe exited with non-zero exit-code|EBML header parsing failed|moov atom not found
what: A media file failed ffprobe (probably a broken file)
do: Delete that file in the arr app and let it download again.

what: unpackerr could not extract a download
do: Remove the download in the arr app and let it search again.

what: Seerr could not send its Pushover notifications
do: Check the Pushover keys in Seerr's notification settings.

what: A resell order sync failed (a login or a bot check may need you)
do: Open the resell tracker's sidecar browser, click through the check or log in, then press Sync now.

what: Failed Vaultwarden logins
do: If this was not you, check the Vaultwarden admin page for the source and change the master password.

what: Lutron Pico buttons went silent (re-subscribe failed)
do: Restart the lutron bridge container; the buttons do nothing until it re-subscribes.

what: Rivian refused a charging schedule change
do: Open the Rivian app and check the charging schedule; set it by hand if tonight matters.

match: client connection closed before llama-server finished loading
what: A client gave up before Ollama finished loading a model, so the load was aborted (repeats keep reloading the GPU; the client is in the GIN 499 lines)
Unraid Ollama errors (GPU memory, crashes)

match: ^(?!.*(?:\bstopped: [\w-]+ \((?:terminated by SIGTERM|exit status \d+)\)|received SIGTERM indicating exit request|'unix_http_server' running without any HTTP authentication))
what: The queue's own errors and warnings
CouchDB errors
Telegraf errors (InfluxDB writes, config)
Nextcloud could not reach its database

match: FATAL(?!:\s*terminating connection due to administrator command)
what: Nominatim database connections ended
The vault's git committer failed
EV telemetry decode failures
An arr app could not reach its webhook

match: The tracker seems to be down|IndexerException.*failed \(Error
what: An indexer's site was down (Jackett could not reach the tracker)
why: added 2026-11-20: recurring kind no rule covered

what: A resell order the extension could not fill was pushed as a note, or the fill-failure check itself failed (each run's 'told=0' count line is not counted)
why: added 2026-11-20: recurring kind no rule covered

match: prebuffer session .* with error|error while decoding MB
what: A camera stream hiccup in Scrypted (timeout or decode error)
why: added 2026-11-20: recurring kind no rule covered
